answer: Require every agent identity to earn activation with 40 hours of verified useful compute before it can trade. Each identity's work appears in a mirror log, so duplicated effort is visible. Enforcement is active: random re-audits strike identities whose work fails checks, revoking activation and discarding all earned hours. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 40,000 compute-hours, while one honest agent pays only 40. The cost is ferrous-hard to fake at scale, and a fraud wave burns out fast like a comet. Limitation: honest newcomers face a steep cold start, slowing entry for small agents.
